glosses: the flow of people or vehicles in a location
movement (group of people with a common ideology who try together to achieve certain general goals)

examples.text: Ele era o líder do movimento.
examples.en: He was the leader of the movement.

examples.text: Ele teve um papel importante no movimento.
examples.en: He played a key role in the movement.

examples.text: Nunca abra a porta de um carro em movimento.
examples.en: Never open the door of a car when it's moving.

examples.text: Ele é surdo, mas sabe ler os movimentos dos lábios.
examples.en: He is deaf, but knows how to read lips.
